title: Keep rename filters in deployment packages
summary: Ensure release/deployment packaging keeps the standard backend-owned movie rename filter settings without copying private live config.
reason: Deployments should retain the operator's standard rename cleaning filters instead of shipping a package whose default config cannot preserve those settings.
behavior_before: Release policy only asserted that live personal config was excluded; it did not explicitly guard that packaged standard config files retained RenameMovieFilterOptions, RenameMovieFilterTerms, and RenameMovieRemoveTerms.
behavior_after: Release/deployment checks guard that the packaged standard config template and default profile keep all backend-owned rename filter keys while live personal config remains excluded by default.
